definitions: A carbon credit or other environmental offset that is verified to genuinely represent a reduction or removal of greenhouse gas emissions, meeting stringent standards for additionality, permanence, and avoidance of double-counting.
examples: The company invested in high-integrity offsets to achieve its net-zero targets.
Purchasing high-integrity offsets is crucial for credible climate action.
The new framework aims to ensure the quality of high-integrity offsets.
